summary.text: Rachel Ventura is a member of the Illinois Senate representing the 43rd Senate District, which includes portions of Bolingbrook, Channahon, Elwood, Joliet, Lockport, Romeoville and Shorewood.
In the 104th General Assembly she chairs the Human Rights Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ventura was born and raised in Joliet and attended public schools.

She received a bachelor's degree in mathematics from Benedictine University and an associate's degree in biology from Tidewater Community College in Virginia, and her past work includes actuary, naturalist, veterinary assistant, substitute teacher and business director.
Ventura served on the Will County Board from 2018 to 2022, chairing its Public Health and Safety Committee, and she also served as vice president of the Forest Preserve District of Will County.

In the Senate she also serves on the Appropriations, Child Welfare, Financial Institutions, Local Government and Public Health committees and is the Illinois state lead for the National Caucus of Environmental Legislators.
